Tastes like Coffee

A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, and Linux

It's a late night and there's not a soul in sight... Until one lone customer walks into your coffee shop. Make drinks, lend an ear, and maybe even make a friend.

CONTAINS:

  • very simple drinkcrafting system☕
  • a burned out comic creator (not you!)
  • an android barista (that's you!)
  • original soundtrack by my epic friend (and featuring another swag artist)
  • Some Bad Endings, a Mid Ending, a Good Ending, and a True Ending

CREDITS:

  • daniople - writer, programmer, sprite artist
  • CaffeDoro - assistant writer
  • graphiteonwhite - assistant programmer
  • Shauntaro - background artist
  • temathy - musician
  • SupItsZaire - featured musician (https://twitter.com/SupItsZaire)

Fonts Used: Boba Date by salinsley!

Install instructions

Mac:

  • Unzip tasteslikecoffee-1.2-mac.zip
  • Run tastes like coffee
  • Mac will tell you 'nooo i cant check this for malware :('
  • You may have to open System Preferences and go to Security & Privacy
  • Click 'Open' to run it anyway (may take a few attempts)

Windows:

  • Unzip tasteslikecoffee-1.2-win.zip
  • Download file and unzip to wherever you'd like
  • Open folder and select tastes like coffee to run

Linux:

  • Download file and unzip to wherever you'd like
  • Run file tasteslikecoffee-1.2-pc.zip

thank you for checking out my game! creating something like a ‘cooking sim’ in ren’py sounds difficult but i dont think its impossible imo :o TLC is a very rough rudimentary idea of a simulator (clicking on things and putting ingredients together in a list) but i think it was a good foundation for a basic idea should i ever decide to make something a little more complicated. :) i recommend checking out ‘a tavern for tea’ by npckc and ‘va-11 hall-a’ (which was originally made in ren’py before they switched to gamemaker), which follow the same premise of being a drink-making sim! maybe they can help somehow!

best of luck with your own ideas! id love to give it a play should it come to fruition :)
